items.title: Dick Katz interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: And we used to have different horn players — Art Farmer, Donald Byrd, Gigi Gryce.

ctx.x: So they didn’t have the headache or expense of trying to hold a band together.

No. I worked with them a lot in the old Half Note, I used to work down there. And let’s see, you want to point me, now let’s see after, oh yeah, the best job I had, after I left Kai and J.J. and was freelancing with everybody, I played with — I was in the house rhythm section at the Café Bohemia with Oscar Pettiford and Kenny Clarke. That was one of the greatest experiences. And we used to have different horn players — Art Farmer, Donald Byrd, Gigi Gryce.
